reliability.rationale: The autoregressive reference improves five-participant pressure forecast MAE0.49151 to0.37185cmH2O, while every proposed physical extension loses to the flexible control.

mechanism.rationale: Gauge pressure is a measured signal; absent independent muscle pressure/flow-volume identification prevents interpreting fitted lags as resistance or compliance.

novelty.rationale: Source-publication review is disclosed, but the model families are established and the search is targeted. No literature-priority certification.

significance.rationale: A useful causal signal-forecasting test, not a clinical utility result. Assess independent patient populations and device/protocol transfer separately.

reproducibility.rationale: Executable coefficients, native anchors and group evidence are present; independent computational review checks arithmetic separately.

impact.rationale: No independent clinical, industrial, financial or experimental intervention benefit was measured.

checks: Inspected native units/endpoint audit, source prior art, frozen information budget and selection history
Read every comparator and group error including adverse retrospective winners
Separated calibrated prediction, mechanistic interpretation and novelty/impact claims
limitations: Gauge pressure is a measured signal; absent independent muscle pressure/flow-volume identification prevents interpreting fitted lags as resistance or compliance.
